segments.text: Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?
segments.translation: 为什么警察不得不把珍珠推离主要街道？

segments.text: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital.
segments.translation: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定送一些礼物给儿童医院。

segments.text: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a 'guard of honour' of six pretty girls,
segments.translation: 他打扮成圣诞老人的模样，在6个漂亮姑娘组成的'仪仗队'的陪同下，

segments.text: he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
segments.translation: 骑着一头名叫珍珠的小象沿城里的主要街道出发了。

segments.text: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
segments.translation: 他本该知道警察决不会允许这类事情。

segments.text: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
segments.translation: 一个警察走过来对吉米说，他应该走一条小街，因为珍珠阻碍了交通。

segments.text: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
segments.translation: 虽然吉米同意马上就走，但珍珠却拒绝移动。

segments.text: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
segments.translation: 15个警察不得不用很大力气才把它从主要街道推开。

segments.text: The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused.
segments.translation: 警察虽然费了很大劲，但他们还是很开心。

segments.text: 'Jumbo must weigh a few tons,' said a policeman afterwards,
segments.translation: '珍珠一定有好几吨重，'一个警察后来说，

segments.text: 'so it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him.
segments.translation: '幸运的是我们不用把它抬走。

segments.text: Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.'
segments.translation: 当然，我们应该逮捕它，但鉴于它没有前科，这次我们就放了它。'
